name: @org/mfe-monorepo-template
description: React microfrontend monorepo template (pnpm workspaces + Nx + webpack 5 + Module Federation 2)

storybook.description: Storybook dev server of @org/ui (pnpm storybook). Not per zone: intranet tools port only (3192).

storybookTest.description: Static Storybook server for the @org/ui a11y and visual tests (pnpm test:ui). Intranet tools port only (3193).
